Cocktails are ridiculously good
Nov 2022
The head bartender is relatively new (he called himself Vodka, had been working there 7 months) and he has upped this place significantly by revamping the cocktail menu. For ~7 USD you can get some really solid craft cocktails. Mine had whiskey/amaretto base with rosemary and cinnamon for aromatics. It came smoked, and then they lit the rosemary garnish on fire for some additional flavor. They also have a happy hour special from 4-8PM, buy one get one free of the same type of drink. I loved my drink so much that I wasn't complaining to have two in a row. The views at the top are spectacular with choice of city or beach view. Vodka knows his stuff and I would highly reccommend coming here for drinks after dinner or for a date.

Call Before You Go To Make Sure Open!
May 2018 • Couples
We were so disappointed. We have little time to visit this part of the world so carefully researched where we wanted to go. For our Friday evening plans we had many options but Sky Bar is what we chose. Trip Advisor and online reviews looked good and so did the website. We booked a GRAB taxi across the city specifically to go to Sky Bar. On arrival, the hotel reception stopped us from going up to the restaurant saying that it was closed for some work. This valuable information was not on the website. Learn from our error and call ahead.

By the way, the area the Sky Bar is located in is not the nicest and slightly off the main strip. The hotel from the outside and what we saw of the lobby was a little surprising and not in a good way, before we knew the restaurant was closed we hoped that once we got up to the restaurant it would be a different story!

Good view, average food, bad service
Jul 2017 • Couples
We came here to watch the dragon bridge show, have a drink and some dinner. The prices were reasonable and the view of the dragon bridge good (two buildings blocked part of the bridge but you could see the head and it was a lot closer than sky36 would have been). However, the staff did not seem to be interested in us (even though we were the only ones here for most of it) and we had to walk up to them to place our order as no one was coming over. I tried to order the käsespätzle, which they did not have, and the kimchi soup, which they did not have, until finally opting for the rigatoni with pesto and parmesan (which was really tough pasta with greens and cheddar). My partner had a burger which was alright. The staff seemed to struggle with english as they got our order wrong and overall the service was under par.

Pleasantly Surprised
Aug 2016 • Couples
My girlfriend and I were looking for restaurants near the Dragon Bridge. They have a show at the Dragon Bridge at 9 so we wanted to eat after. We looked up nearby restaurants on trip advisors, and while there were a couple to choose from, we decided to come here. 

 We left happy to say the least. Firstly, this place has an amazing view. I was actually shocked that there weren't more people here to watch the dragon bridge (blow fire and water out from its mouth... Look it up). Anyways, the view is spectacular and there was a nice breeze going on at the time when we visited which was very nice considering how humid and hot it can be over here. 

 The restaurant itself is quite cozy as some other reviewers have suggested. Small, but honestly, compared to other restaurants, we quite enjoyed it. 

 I used to be a server growing up so I'm all about the service industry.. Our server, Thuy, was very kind, hospitable, and certainly anticipated our needs. We made small talk and told her we were Canadians and asked what she could recommend to see around Da Nang. She went out of her way to show us photos of great places to see and told us a little bit about each place! Thank you for that Thuy.

 The food was decent! It was a majority european dishes with some asian dishes. We just decided to order spring rolls and German sausage. Honestly, we weren't expecting much (based on some reviews) but were pleasantly surprised with the food. It's no European fine dining cuisine, but it was tasty. The prices were certainly cheap too. So when you get cheap food that doesn't taste bad, and in this case left us satisfies, that's definitely a good find.

 So I hope my opinion provides some insight about this place. 

Cheers,

J & T
